   98.5  Flap or pedicle graft
   NOTE:  1. Functional areas includes the following anatomical areas:
             Head, neck, axillae, elbow, wrist, hand, groin, perineum,
             hip, knee, ankle, foot and includes coverage of exposed
             vital structures (bone, tendon, major vessel, nerve)
          2. Flaps (HSCs 98.53,98.5A,98.51A,98.51B) for functional areas
             are designated by FNCAR modifier, add 50% to total benefit.
          3. Flap size 5-10 cms or double Z-plasty designated by 2ZPL
             modifier, add 25% to benefit.
          4. Flap size greater than 10 cms or triple Z-plasty designated
             by 3ZPL modifier, add 50% to benefit.
          5. Composite tissue resection (includes bone) designated by
             CMPRSC modifier, add 25% to benefit.
          6. Only one modifier (CMPRSC, FNCAR, 2ZPL, 3ZPL) may be claimed
             per flap.
